summary_text: Recent Developments: Merger Filing Update - The companies filed an amended merger application on April 30, 2026, projecting that shippers will save $3.5 billion annually if the deal receives regulatory approval. Union Pacific will exit deal if STB orders widespread line sales or trackage rights. Q1 Earnings Performance - Union Pacific Corp reported better-than-expected earnings for the first quarter on Thursday. The freight company posted a profit in the first quarter of $1.70 billion, or $2.87 a share, on revenue of $6.22 billion. Trains are getting faster, with freight car velocity rising 9% to 235 daily miles per car, and average terminal dwell improving by 11% to 19.7 hours. Stock Performance - UNP remains in focus amid bullish analyst sentiment and significant merger discussions. The main focus for UNP this week continues to be the proposed $85 billion merger with Norfolk Southern, undergoing regulatory review from the Surface Transportation Board (STB).
